source: Project Stonewall deal team meeting, Thu 10/22
author: axe
text:
Meeting transcript · Project Stonewall · Thursday 2026-10-22, 2:00 PM ET
Attendees: Axe, Ari Spyros (deal team), Mike Wagner (compliance)

Axe: Where are we on the banks?
Ari: Two banks are in. Both say commitment letters by November 15. Together they cover $1.9 billion; the rest comes from our own cash.
Axe: Good. And the price?
Ari: Base case is 11x next year's earnings. That's where $52.75 comes from.
Axe: Then that's the offer. Announcement stays November 10. I want it out before her Q4 letter.
Ari: TMC's counsel wants a standstill before they open the data room. Eighteen months, no buying TMC shares without their consent.
Axe: Twelve months, and it falls away if anyone else bids. Tell them that.
Mike Wagner: Reminder: everything about Stonewall stays with the three of us and the deal analyst. Research and the desk don't hear a word until it's announced.
Axe: Understood. Ari, get the valuation model into the deal folder by Saturday.
Ari: Will do.
